prompt: A technical writer needs to fix a typo in the docs and open a pull request from the browser — without spinning up a whole environment. Which surface fits exactly?
explanation: github.dev is the light-edit middle ground: full editor in the browser, no terminal or process execution. When you need to build, run, or debug, that is the codespace’s job.

options.text: github.dev — quick edits and PRs, nothing executing
A codespace — because editing requires a container
GitHub Desktop — because every edit needs a local clone
The Copilot cloud agent — because it edits files for you
